action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/am.js',errors='ignore').read()
for kw in ['x-captcha','captcha-response','recaptchaToken','6Lf','captchaToken']:
    for m in list(re.finditer(kw,s,re.I))[:4]:
        print(f"[{kw}] {re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',s[max(0,m.start()-300):m.start()+300])}\n")
    print('='*60)
PY
